---
name: Bug report
about: Something crashed, is slow, or misbehaves
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**What happened?**
A sentence is fine.

**What did you run?**
The exact command, e.g. `./bin/fastollama serve`.

**Model + settings**
Model name from `settings.txt` and anything non-default you changed.

**Output**
Paste the relevant log from `logs/` (last ~30 lines is plenty).

**Hardware**
GPU / VRAM / CPU / RAM — e.g. "9070 XT 16 GB, Ryzen 7 9700X, 32 GB".
